references.text: The first and seventh days shall be a holy convocation, and no work shall be done on these days—the same command regarding the holy convocation and the prohibition of work during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
Fire offering to the Lord—description of fire offerings as a pleasing aroma to the Lord.
Detailed description of the fire offerings to be brought over seven days during the Feast of Unleavened Bread, with a holy convocation on the seventh day.
Holy convocation where no work shall be done—the same pattern of festival gathering and prohibition of work.
The Sabbath principle with a holy convocation and prohibition against work—the basic pattern for all holy gatherings.
The same wording regarding a holy convocation and prohibition against any kind of work.
The Feast of Tabernacles with a holy convocation, fire offerings, and prohibition against work—parallel festival structure.
The seventh day as a festival gathering to the Lord, with prohibition against work.
